Quotes must each occur exactly once on their page, so I kept them to the service name plus the cost from the same row.

Facts I included:
- Outpatient x-rays: $25 in network and 50% out of network.
- Diagnostic mammography: $0 in network and 50% out of network.
- Diagnostic radiology (MRI, CT, etc.): $300 in network and 50% out of network.
- Diagnostic tests and procedures: I left this out. It is not clearly one of the listed imaging benefits.

The "Diagnostic radiology (MRI, CT, etc.)" row ends in "etc.", so the document does not list exactly the services it covers. That rules out `imaging.diagnostic.advanced`. The service is named as diagnostic radiology, so I mapped it to `imaging.diagnostic`. It is the most defensible choice, but I flagged it in a note.

The page 5 columns are in-network then out-of-network. I quoted each row's full text with its first amount for in network and its second amount for out of network.
